note: Code 0 is the divergence that matters: it is 2^-127, a SUBNORMAL float, not zero and not the smallest normal. A decoder using __uint_as_float(code << 23) returns +0.0 here and +Inf at 255. That shortcut is sound only under the producer contract (an all-zero block carries code 0 with all-zero elements), so a backend may ship it -- but it must not claim conformance.

cases.note: NaN; the format has no infinity
